newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Hylsamex plans $100 mln share issue.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Hylsamex plans $100 mln share issue.

text.p: Mexican steel maker Hylsamex SA is planning a share issue to raise around $100 million, the company's president said Thursday.
Hylsamex is the steel arm of Mexico's huge conglomerate Grupo Industrial Alfa SA based here in this northern city.
Questioned about new projects that Alfa has in the pipeline, Dionisio Garza Medina said the steel company planned a share issue. "I believe for around $100 million," he said.
Interviewed at the end of a business forum here, Garza Medina gave no date for the issue but hinted that it could be toward the end of the year.
"If the (equity) market continues to be healthy, it could be before the year is out," he said. He gave no details on what the money would be used for.
Garza Medina said the board of Hylsamex is also studying the possibility of extending its "mini-mill" steel plant in Monterrey.
"The mini-mill has 750,000 tonnes (installed capacity per year) on the first line and with a marginal investment we can make the second (production line)," he said.
